correctness.rationale: The full facet structure of the open neighborhood complex is established combinatorially. All edges of each 10-vertex component occur in exactly one of ten triangles, giving a primitive rank-ten triangle boundary and free rank-eleven H1. The signed trace table follows by all oriented fixed simplices; two independently constructed checkers reproduce exact ranks, all 120 permutations and induced rational H1 matrices. Specht character summation proves the module. Inversion-free barycentric subdivision and one transitive flag orbit prove the orbit space a genuine 2-simplex. All hypotheses and limits are explicit.

value.rationale: The Desargues Levi graph is a natural canonical symmetric cubic graph. The action of its entire 240-element graph automorphism group on both nontrivial reduced homology degrees is a complete structural topological invariant beyond the known wedge form and graph automorphism group. Its 6+5 Specht split, central swap character, and the precise triangle orbit-space homeomorphism offer meaningful equivariant topology and an independently reproducible calculation; no arbitrary unmotivated parameter restriction is introduced.
